seed_selection: Three unique system-random uint32 values excluded from recognized metadata, the prior failed panel and all six previous reservations; no previous outcome was read for selection.
purpose: A separately registered exploratory comparison of the weighted and unweighted task-choice models after supervised Job remediation; not a completion or retry of the failed panel.
panel: Three new seeds, frozen round2 and market opponents, both seats and both models; 24 official games, 24 primary replays, one preselected independent-process replay.
acceptance: Every game: 720 states, 719 actions, both DONE, zero errors, fixed engine/model identities, persisted per-game Job and worker receipts; full ledger reverified, then independent replay.
statistics: Whole-seed clusters; 10000 bootstrap draws descriptive only. Pair own-profit and margin deltas >= -2000, seed-opponent seat means >= -1000; equality passes. Three clusters cannot show significance or justify automatic promotion.
resources: Three 4GiB available-memory samples before each game; 2GiB sampled host floor, bounded owned Job, 12-hour overall deadline; sampling is not a hard system or GPU cap.
stop_conditions: Any identity, resource, game, supervision, receipt, replay or cleanup failure after marker stops without retry, replacement or additional seeds.
boundaries: No training, PPO, source strategy/default Bot or official rule modifications; raw replays, traces, logs and model weights remain private.
provenance: Independent subagent advice and code review, not WebChat.
